title: Feature status
description: profiles/<slug>/tickets/<id>/outputs/status.json: a feature's status ('Where we are'), kept in its top ticket's outputs folder. Type SavedStatus in src/board/feature.ts; written by writeStatus in src/board/feature.ts (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, no final newline, written to status.json.tmp then renamed) from applyPatch (Claude's update_status), addStatusNote and the note delivery (src/board/board-features.ts) and landMilestone (src/board/board-main.ts). Only updatedAt is always there: a status made by a note or a milestone has no claudeAt or familySig, and sections Claude cleared are removed, not set to null. Board facts (counts, test rounds, pull requests, saved changes) are not saved here; they are worked out from ticket data. readStatus treats a file whose updatedAt isn't a string as no status. Unknown fields must be kept.

goal.description: Claude's section, trimmed, at most 2000 chars (longer text ends with '… (cut short)').

prNotes.description: Map: pull request URL to Claude's note on it (e.g. 'on staging'), at most 200 chars.

notes.description: 'Add a note': what the user added from outside the board, oldest first.

delivered.description: Claude in the main chat got it (at its next turn).

familySig.description: The family as it was at Claude's last update_status (familySig in feature.ts); '' for an empty family.

milestones.description: Milestones the main ticket landed (land_milestone), oldest first, the last 20.

landed.description: How it landed, in plain words (e.g. 'already in the project folder').
